Core rotation: Lightstream (crit buff) → Evoke + Dark Resurrection → Return → Celestial Rain → Mysterious Stampede. Use Chancellor + Royal (draw 2 cards) before damage window. Prioritize Cull/Twisted Fate/Sovereign for damage increases; Joy reduces cooldowns; Wheel of Fortune resets next skill cooldown.
